assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE individual transparent full-body female medical character sprite for a realistic illustrated 2D side-view science-fiction adventure.
The reference image establishes rendering finish, proportions, subdued material detail and camera angle ONLY; create a different person.
Subject: the unnamed medical attendant aboard the Carlyle as described in the authorized Chapter Four excerpt of Alien: Sea of Sorrows: a stout woman around forty, graying brown hair pulled back in a bun, blue eyes behind fairly thick glasses, wearing a white lab coat. Calm professional expression. These described traits must be clearly readable. Her exact face and height are unspecified, so use an original ordinary face and normal game-character proportions without likeness to an actor.
Stand facing screen-right in a relaxed three-quarter side pose. Hold one plain clipboard with paper lightly against the abdomen, hands anatomically correct and visible. Simple dark practical trousers and flat closed shoes under the white coat, without invented insignia or name badge.
Composition: one complete person from hair to soles, centered in a 1024x1536 portrait canvas, generous empty margins, feet on a level line. Match the reference's realistic painted game-sprite finish and gentle neutral light.
Genuine transparent RGBA background. No room, chair, floor, ground shadow, glow, vignette, text, border, duplicates, weapons or sprite sheet.
